body:
Ideally, the module behavior should probably be updated to work as outlined in the docs written for the `directory` module:

- Paths beginning with the home directory will be contracted to `~`
- Paths containing a git repo will contract to begin at the repo root

That would mean the home directory, despite being a repo, would display as `~`.

> Can truncation_length possibly affect the output of this test? If so, we should disable it altogether.

I don't believe it should.

> Can any of the proposed PRs for directory configuration (e.g. #192) possibly affect test correctness?

The home directory should remain unaffected, regardless of the truncation method.
`$HOME` should display as `~`.

> Should we review our tests for potential environmental dependencies?

I don't think we need to actively review them right now, but it's a reminder to keep the environment state in mind while working on tests.

> What should the correct starship behavior (not just test behavior) be if HOME is a git directory but truncate_to_repo is set?

The path should truncate to the repo root directory, but it should still respect the previous directory rules of substituting `$HOME` with `~`. In the end, being a repo root should've done nothing. 

`directory` was the first module that was written for the prompt, so I wouldn't be surprised to hear it needs refactoring.

I think this is a good temporary fix, but we should probably re-evaluate the implementation of `directory`.
